title: On the Challenges of Using LLMs in High-Risk AI Recruitment: Guiding Questions for Legal Conformity with the AI Act
abstract: arXiv:2611.27462v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) imposes detailed obligations on providers of high-risk AI systems but offers limited operational guidance, particularly when these systems integrate third-party General-Purpose AI (GPAI) models. This paper introduces a toolkit that fosters the development of legal-by-design AI-assisted recruitment systems by translating the core legal obligations of the AI Act's conformity assessment---specifically Articles 9--15 and Annex IV---into techno-normative requirements and corresponding guiding questions. While recruitment pipelines may involve components with varying technical complexity and differing levels of algorithmic transparency, this paper focuses on the most challenging case: the integration of third-party GPAI models into critical stages of the selection process, including resume and job description parsing, applicant scoring, and shortlist generation. translated_title: 关于在高风险AI招聘中使用大语言模型的挑战：符合《人工智能法案》法律合规性的指导性问题
translated_abstract: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（AI Act）对高风险AI系统的提供者规定了详细的义务，但在操作层面提供的指导有限，尤其是当这些系统集成了第三方通用人工智能（GPAI）模型时。本文介绍了一个工具包，通过将AI法案合规评估的核心法律义务——具体为第9-15条和附件IV——转化为技术规范要求及相应的指导性问题，从而促进“合法设计”的AI辅助招聘系统的开发。虽然招聘流程可能包含技术复杂程度不同、算法透明度各异的组件，但本文聚焦于最具挑战性的情形：将第三方GPAI模型集成到选拔过程的关键阶段，包括简历与职位描述解析、申请人评分以及入围名单生成。这一情形带来了重大的挑战……
tldr: 本文提出一个工具包，将欧盟《人工智能法案》合规评估的核心法律义务转化为技术规范要求和指导性问题，以支持“合法设计”的AI辅助招聘系统开发，重点关注第三方GPAI模型集成到招聘关键环节这一最具挑战性的场景。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a toolkit that translates the EU AI Act's core conformity-assessment obligations into techno-normative requirements and guiding questions, supporting legal-by-design AI-assisted recruitment systems with a focus on the challenging integration of third-party GPAI models.
